context_for_next_testing_agent: Visit CRUD endpoints fully tested and working. Key findings: (1) Auth returns 'access_token' field correctly, (2) GET /api/visits returns list with visit_id, user_id, landmark_id, (3) GET /api/visits/{visit_id} returns photos, verified, points_earned, visibility fields, (4) PUT /api/visits/{visit_id} updates diary_notes (stored as 'diary'), photos array, share_diary, (5) PUT /api/visits/{visit_id}/privacy updates visibility to public/friends/private, (6) DELETE /api/visits/{visit_id} removes visit and returns 404 on subsequent GET.
